landscape.summary: Onchain credit is polarizing into modular, isolated architectures across both EVM and non-EVM ecosystems. While major lending protocols highlight vault curation and institutional debt expansion, Stellar's live Protocol 20 rollout and Blend v2's $150M pool scale establish an active lending substrate on Soroban. The broader market remains focused on leverage efficiency and credit sandboxing, creating an opening for unified margin solutions built around borrower isolation.

landscape.for_vanna: The operational maturity of Blend v2 and Soroban Protocol 20 provides Vanna with an immediate, liquid lending layer on Stellar to benchmark its testnet SmartAccounts. As EVM protocols validate credit accounts for structured yield, Vanna can establish itself as the premier isolated credit and 1.10x liquidation buffer layer on Soroban before mainnet deployment. Focusing testnet simulations on Blend pool routing will turn market interest in isolated credit into practical proof of execution.
